inventory_list_note: Each row is one SKU at one location in one unit. Quantities from each source stay separate. “Not reported” means the source hasn’t sent a value.
inventory_offline: You’re offline. Reconnect to refresh stock.
inventory_list_caption: Stock by SKU, location, and source
inventory_list_unmatched_body: Try another SKU, location, or source.
inventory_list_empty_body: Stock appears here after Luma imports it from a connected store or ERP. Check Data sync for progress.
inventory_list_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} stock position on this page} other {{count, number} stock positions on this page}}
inventory_detail_load_failed: Luma couldn’t load this stock position.
inventory_explanation_agree: What each source reports for this position
inventory_explanation_differs_body: Sources disagree on {fields} stock. Compare read times and availability methods before deciding which quantity to trust.
inventory_explanation_syncing_body: Sources disagree on {fields} stock. Luma first saw the gap at {since} and expects the sync between the sources to close it. If it is still open at {until}, Luma raises an issue.
inventory_explanation_agree_body: Only reported quantities are compared. Agreement doesn’t confirm a fresh read or make any source the authority.
inventory_explanation_separate: Quantities are shown per source and never added together. Refresh shows Luma’s latest readings; it doesn’t read the sources again.
inventory_orders_note: Order quantities as each source reports them. Luma can’t confirm which location fulfills them or how much demand remains.
inventory_orders_empty: No orders Luma has read include this SKU.
inventory_supply_note: Purchase order quantities aren’t confirmed incoming stock. Luma doesn’t know the receipt progress or the destination location.
inventory_supply_empty: No purchase orders for this SKU.
inventory_issues_empty: No issues recorded for this SKU or position.
inventory_related_truncated: Showing the first 50 entries for each kind of related record. Open Orders or Procurement to see more.
inventory_history_note: Readings Luma recorded from each source, newest first. A reading shows what the source reported, not necessarily a stock movement. “Current” marks the reading Luma uses for that source.
inventory_history_truncated: {count, plural, one {Showing the most recent reading.} other {Showing the {count, number} most recent readings.}}
inventory_provider_states_note: Shopify committed stock and its separate reserved state have different meanings. Quantities stay as reported; incoming stock is not added to available stock. Activation does not establish stock ownership.
inventory_write_matches: Luma set available stock to {quantity}. This read matches; other changes may also have occurred.
inventory_write_changed: Luma set available stock to {quantity}. This read differs; other changes remain unattributed.
inventory_write_unknown: Luma set available stock to {quantity}. The current quantity is unknown.
inventory_transfer_intro: Follow requested, shipped and received units. These records provide context; stock quantities stay separate.
inventory_transfer_empty: No transfers or shipments in this view
inventory_transfer_empty_body: Enable the separate transfer and shipment read grants on a Shopify connection and sync those record types.
inventory_transfer_stale: Evidence is stale; receiving checks are paused.
inventory_transfer_incomplete: Line collection unavailable or unsupported; receiving checks are paused.
inventory_transfer_unavailable: Source unavailable or read grant missing; receiving checks are paused.
inventory_transfer_inconsistent_quantiti: Reported quantities do not reconcile. Refresh the source before drawing conclusions.
inventory_transfer_rejected: The source reports rejected units. Inspect receiving evidence before preparing a claim.
inventory_transfer_terminal_unreceived: The shipment is marked received with units still unreceived.
inventory_transfer_receipt_late: Receipt remains unconfirmed after the estimated arrival. This does not establish physical loss.
inventory_transfer_location_unknown: Live location identity unavailable. The historical name does not establish a stock pool.
inventory_transfer_no_relationships: No explicit relationship recorded. Matching names, SKUs or quantities do not establish a link.
inventory_transfer_procurement_hidden: Procurement access is required to view linked purchase orders.
inventory_transfer_claim_context: The evidence pack retains source identities, observations and explicit links. Supplier confirmations, delivery documents, photos and a claim deadline require separate evidence and policy. Downloading does not submit a claim.
inventory_transfer_truncated: More history or related records exist than this view can show.
inventory_transfer_relationships_unknown: Shipment relationships were unavailable in this read. Check the shipment read grant.
